subject: Leadership readiness: QBR talking points and escalation Q&A
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 May 2028 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Leadership readiness: QBR talking points and escalation Q&A

Team —

Attached is a rehearsal draft of the leadership talking points for next week's QBR plus a short Q&A sheet for expected questions about the organization changes and OKR updates. High-level ask: please review and flag anything that is tone-sensitive or that will trigger legal/finance review.

Top areas I want eyes on:
- Slide 3 (strategy shift): language around "focus and consolidation" — is this strong enough without sounding like layoffs?
- Q&A: add a concise line on customer SLAs and fallback models (we need a single sentence we can read from the stage).
- Escalation flow: see attached PDF — confirm owner assignments are correct.

Timeline: please send comments in-line by 11:00 PT today. I will consolidate for a 12:00 dry run.

Attachments: QBR_TalkingPoints_v3.docx, org-chart-v2.png, escalation-flow.pdf

Thanks,
Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Head of People Ops | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 May 2028 08:45:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Leadership readiness: QBR talking points and escalation Q&A

On Tue, 22 May 2028 at 08:14, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Team —
>
> Attached is a rehearsal draft of the leadership talking points for next week's QBR plus a short Q&A sheet for expected questions about the organization changes and OKR updates. High-level ask: please review and flag anything that is tone-sensitive or that will trigger legal/finance review.

Thanks Naomi — quick thoughts inline: 

> - Slide 3 (strategy shift): language around "focus and consolidation" — is this strong enough without sounding like layoffs?

> Recommendation: swap "consolidation" -> "streamline ownership". Keeps it about structure and responsibilities rather than headcount.

> - Q&A: add a concise line on customer SLAs and fallback models (we need a single sentence we can read from the stage).

Agree. Suggest: "We have defined fallback routing and verified performance targets; customer-facing SLAs remain unchanged while we consolidate operational ownership." Short and defensible.

> - Escalation flow: see attached PDF — confirm owner assignments are correct.

Two owners flagged (ops and platform) look correct; please add contact for legal ops (for any contractual exceptions). Also add a one-liner that we will honor existing commitments for customers under active contracts.

I'll do a light copy edit on the opening paragraph and return by 10:30.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
VP, Product | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Wallace <ben.wallace@prospectco.com>
Date: Tue, 22 May 2028 09:30:44 -0700
Subject: Re: Leadership readiness: QBR talking points and escalation Q&A

Looping Ben in for visibility on the customer angle; Ben, feel free to jump in if you have any specific concerns we should preempt.

Naomi / team — a couple of tactical asks from my side: 
- Please add a slide with two rapid customer-impact scenarios (best / worst case) and a single-slide mitigation playbook so the execs can answer "what if a major customer sees increased latency" in 60 seconds.
- OKR phrasing: on the slide that says "reduce duplication across pods", let's reword to "improve clarity of ownership to reduce overlap" — it's less operationally accusatory and fits better with our compensation/OKR goals.
- Add one-line talking point about Dedicated vs Private capacity options (we should not force-hosted as the default in the script).

I made three small comments in the doc (QBR_TalkingPoints_v3.docx). No legal flags from my side; Marissa's wording change for the opening para sounds good.

Jonas
Jonas Weber
Head of Platform Strategy | Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai

- Opening para updated per Marissa's edit (softer language).
- OKR phrasing changed as Jonas suggested.
- Added 1-slide customer-impact scenarios and the mitigation playbook.
- Added legal contact line and the single SLA sentence for the stage.

Attachments now: QBR_TalkingPoints_v3_final.docx, org-chart-v2.png, escalation-flow.pdf
